Senior Platform Engineer - search

What we're looking for: a platform engineer who has built and operated scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure for several years, and who is happy owning the systems they build. You will work on the deployment platform the whole engineering organisation ships through, so the work is equal parts Kubernetes, Terraform and talking to the teams who depend on it.

About the team: eleven engineers across London and Lisbon, shipping to production several times a day, on call one week in six with a rota that is actually respected. We are looking for someone who has done this at a company of a similar size and wants to do it again with a clean slate.
